students.title: Class List
students.item1: Create as many classes as you like in the class manager and switch between them – each class keeps its own students, seating plans and classrooms.
students.item2: Add students one by one, create placeholders for a whole class, or import a CSV file – "What the file looks like" shows the required structure.
students.item3: Select up to 3 preferred and distance partners per student – the order determines priority.
students.item4: Search, filter and sorting help you find individual students; the checkboxes let you edit several students at once.
students.item5: Add photos via the portrait icon – they stay on this device only.
students.item6: Undo and redo changes in the class list with the corresponding icons.

layout.title: Classroom
layout.item1: Choose a template or add tables by clicking.
layout.item2: Move and rotate tables via drag & drop.
layout.item3: Multi-select: Shift or Ctrl/Cmd + click, or draw a selection rectangle.
layout.item4: Right-click (desktop) or long press (touch) opens the context menu.
layout.item5: Save custom classroom templates via the sidebar.
layout.item6: Drag room elements such as windows, door, desk, blackboard, whiteboard, cabinet or divider from the sidebar into the room and resize them if needed.
layout.item7: Undo and redo changes in the classroom with the corresponding icons.

plan.title: Seating Plan
plan.item1: Adjust the weighting of criteria (0-10) in the sidebar – in the collapsed sidebar with a right click or a long press on the icon.
plan.item2: Drag students to other seats via drag & drop.
plan.item3: Click the lock icon to lock a seat for the next shuffle.
plan.item4: The statistics display shows how well the criteria are met – the values then sit beside the criteria in the options.
plan.item5: The view settings control how names appear (first name only, first name + initial, or first and last name) and whether photos are shown.
plan.item6: Undo and redo changes to the seating plan with the corresponding icons.

circle.title: Seating Circle
circle.item1: Drag students to new positions via drag & drop.
circle.item2: Green lines show connections to table neighbors in the seating plan.
circle.item3: Show or hide connections in the sidebar.
circle.item4: The circle starts out linked to the seating plan, but you can change it and save and export it separately.

export.title: Export
export.item1: Customize the name of your seating plan.
export.item2: Switch between portrait and landscape format for PDF export.
export.itemFlip: Set the viewing direction under page format: "From the back" rotates the room by 180° for a desk at the back, so names stay readable.
export.item3: Use the sidebar to decide what is shown: room elements, needs, photos, legend and additional class info.
export.itemNames: Choose how names appear: first name only, first name + last name initial, or first and last name.
export.item4: Toggle preview between Seating Plan and Seating Circle (top right).
export.item5: Besides PDF and print you can save the view as a PNG image or an SVG vector graphic.

present.title: Presentation mode
present.item1: The bar at the bottom switches between teacher and student view as well as between seating plan and circle.
present.item2: The student view shows the plan from the class's perspective – without markers and photos.
present.item3: Show or hide markers, photos, colors and room elements using the bar at the bottom.
present.itemNames: The "Names" button switches the display between first name, first name + last name initial, and first and last name.
present.itemContrast: Contrast mode shows the plan black on white with thicker outlines – for bright rooms and weak projectors.
present.item4: Set the size with the slider or the mouse wheel and drag to pan; the centre icon resets the view.
present.item5: Press Alt + ← to return to the generator.
present.item6: "Who's next?" draws a random student and spotlights their seat – everyone gets a turn before anyone repeats.
present.item7: Keyboard: F fullscreen, Space draws a student, Esc resets the draw, + / − zoom, 0 recenters.
present.itemFullscreen: In fullscreen the wall belongs to the plan: the strip on top goes away, and the bar at the bottom appears when the pointer nears the bottom edge or you tap there, then slides away again shortly after.

recommended.desc: Every criterion this class has data for, at its default weight.

quietWork.label: Quiet work
quietWork.desc: Separates what disturbs: restlessness, distractibility, conflicts. Front seats count.

groupWork.desc: Wish partners, peer support and language mixing at one table.

exam.desc: As much distance as possible: wishes do not count, new neighbours do.

newClass.desc: Mix widely, leave nobody sitting alone, spread the roles.

help.title: Help and tour
help.body: Instructions and keyboard shortcuts for every step are here – and this is where you start the tour again at any time.

emptyState.title: Welcome to Klassenplan!
emptyState.body: Create your first class – or load the sample class and try everything with invented students first.

addStudents.title: Add students
addStudents.body: The toolbar on the left fills the class: one by one, as placeholders or from a CSV file. The sample class sits with the import.

classSwitcher.title: Your classes
classSwitcher.body: The header states which class is open. Switch between classes here, create new ones or rename them. Every class has its own students, rooms and seating plans.

backup.title: Back up your data
backup.body: Your data lives only in this browser. "Backup" in the toolbar exports an encrypted backup and restores it – on another device, too.

proceed.title: On to the classroom
proceed.body: Once the list is complete, set up the classroom in the next step.

studentRow.title: Edit students
studentRow.body: Add attributes such as restless, shy, language level, social role or preferred and distance partners. The portrait icon even lets you upload photos.

canvas.title: Your classroom
canvas.body: Move and rotate tables by drag and drop. Right-click or long-press to copy, cut or delete tables.

canvasSettings.title: View settings
canvasSettings.body: Under "View" in the toolbar you set what the room shows — every layer with options of its own. Snapping, the grid, alignment guides, photo collisions and room elements are switched here. In the seating plan you choose whether photos appear and how names are shortened, in the circle also whether connections are visible.

proceed.title: On to the seating plan
proceed.body: The first time it opens, Klassenplan shuffles a seating plan for you.

sidebar.title: Tables and room elements
sidebar.body: Drag tables, windows, doors or the board into the room, among other things. 'Set Up Classroom' arranges tables automatically or loads a saved template for you to keep editing. Your own rooms are saved as templates.

status.title: Seats at a glance
status.body: Shows whether there are enough seats for all students.

canvas.title: Adjust by hand
canvas.body: Drag students to other seats. A click on the lock icon keeps a student in their seat when shuffling.

circle.title: Seating circle
circle.body: Switch between seating plan and seating circle here. The circle is built from the current seating plan and shows table neighbors as connections. You can change it and save and export it separately.

exits.title: Present and export
exits.body: In the status bar at the bottom you show the plan on the board or export it as a PDF. Both save the plan first when something has changed.

fulfillment.title: Criteria and fulfilment
fulfillment.body: On the right you set which criteria count when mixing and how much they weigh. The button above shows in per cent how well the plan meets them and puts a bar under each criterion — hover it and the seats it concerns are marked, click it to keep the marking.

mix.title: Mix
mix.body: The button in the status bar mixes the class again, taking every selected criterion into account (Ctrl/Cmd+M).

sidebar.title: Tools
sidebar.body: Switch between seating plan and circle, set what the plan shows, open the neighbourhoods and earlier plans — and save the plan.

sidebarToggle.title: Expand and collapse the sidebar
sidebarToggle.body: This button expands or collapses the sidebar (⌘/Ctrl+B). Collapsed, it shows its functions as icons and leaves more room for the plan. The sidebar in step 2 and on the export page works the same way.

sceneInspector.empty: Pick a table or a room feature on the plan to rotate, copy or remove it. Moving happens right on the plan.
sceneInspector.title: Properties

whoIsNext.title: Who's next?
whoIsNext.emptyBody: Create a class with names first; this view then draws from it.
whoIsNext.help1: Everyone has a turn before anyone repeats. When the round is over, the next one starts.
whoIsNext.help2: "Skip" draws someone else and leaves the skipped student in the round.
whoIsNext.help3: Keyboard: Space draws, Esc starts over.

seatFinder.title: Where does who sit?
seatFinder.noMatch: Nobody in this plan is called "{{query}}".
seatFinder.emptyBody: This view reads the current seating plan. Shuffle one, and it will say who sits where.
seatFinder.help1: Type a name; once one match is left, it opens by itself.
seatFinder.help2: The plan below lights up the seat, so the sentence can be checked against the room.

groups.title: Build groups
groups.conflict: Could not be kept apart: {{names}}. There are not enough groups for that.
groups.emptyBody: Create a class with names first; this view then draws groups from it.
groups.help1: The groups are drawn afresh every time and are not stored anywhere.
groups.help2: Students with a distance wish stay out of the same group where the sizes allow it.
groups.help3: The seating plan is untouched — a group is for one lesson, a seat for the term.
